resources.string: Scroll Counter counts the Reels, Shorts and short videos you watch — in any social or video app (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat and others) and on short-video websites in your browser. To recognise a reels feed it looks only at the layout of the screen (the size of the video player, its view names and how it scrolls). In browsers it checks the address bar only to recognise short-video pages; addresses are never stored. It does not read or store messages, captions, comments or anything you type, and all data stays on your device. If you turn on uninstall protection, it also sends you back from Scroll Counter\'s own uninstall screens. It also shows a small counter at the top while you watch, and takes you to the home screen once your daily limit is reached.
Today\'s scrolls and how tired your thumb is
Keeps Scroll Counter from being uninstalled on impulse. No admin powers are used.
